# Gus

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P30](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0030)</sub>
- **Role:** barber  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Gus is described as a dwarf of a person. In contrast to others of great physical strength, he possesses a remarkably small frame.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)_

## Personality

Gus is typically known for his small stature and gentle demeanor. However, he is also capable of acting with unexpected savageness when pushed.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)_

## Traits

- gentle  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)</sub>

## Goals

## History

After the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory in the election, Gus's father, [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to discuss politics and share the news. Later, he spent time with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), contemplating his own mortality and asking her to care for his cat, Matey, after his death while listening to her recite poetry.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P26](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039)_
